typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	appDmwebDb as string (),
	appDmwebPassword as string (),
	appDmwebSource as string (),
	appDmwebUser as string (),
	archiveFileNameWithPath as string (),
	archivePath as string (),
	env as string (),
	errorDesc as string (),
	fileDefId as integer (),
	fileDefObj as string (),
	fileFormatConfigId as integer (),
	fileId as integer (),
	fileNameWithPath as string (),
	fileObj as string (),
	filePattern as string (),
	fileStatusConfigId as integer (),
	importLineOrdinal as integer (),
	importPath as string (),
	origFileNameWithPath as string (),
	profileConfigId as integer (),
	storedProc as string (),
	tidalJobNo as string (),
	unstableCheckTime as integer ()
}

source(output(
		importPath as string,
		filePattern as string,
		fileDefId as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	F.fileDefId, 	REPLACE(F.folderPath, \'#rootPath#\', R.configValue) AS importPath, 	F.filePattern FROM [File].[FileDef] F INNER JOIN App.Config E ON E.configKey LIKE \'Env.%\' INNER JOIN App.Config R ON R.envConfigId = E.configId 	AND R.configKeyNode = \'RootPath\' WHERE F.isActive = 1 	AND F.fileDirectionConfigId = 341 	AND E.configKey = \'Env.\' + UPPER(?) 	AND ISNULL(F.profileConfigId,-1) = ? 	AND F.fileDefId = ? ORDER BY F.ordinal',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		importPath as string,
		filePattern as string,
		fileDefId as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		importPath,
		filePattern,
		fileDefId)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderRecordsetDestination
